purpose: Qualify paid observation, action change, real local effects and complete bounded accounting before any NDU comparison.
provenance: Synthetic disposable SQLite schema-repair tasks; no real user task, learned policy or HIA native policy.
task: Increment each existing counter by delta exactly once. There is one counter_a or counter_b column. READ observes PRAGMA table_info; the policy never receives fixture mode or evaluator labels before termination.
observation_model: Perfect schema observation on normal fixtures. One separately registered invalid-schema control makes READ fail; retain that task in every arm's denominator.

controls.fixed: Choose a fixed read-fee threshold and default repair from shared calibration; after a paid READ use its observed schema. Freeze before heldout execution.
controls.voi: Exact one-step value of perfect information versus the best feasible no-read action, using rational arithmetic and the original remaining tariff budget.
controls.mpc: Independently enumerate the complete finite action/observation tree, including STOP, action fees and remaining tariff budget; no free oracle about realized fixture mode.
controls.ties: STOP, REPAIR_A, REPAIR_B, READ in that order. All controls receive the same public model, calibration observations, action rights and original budgets.

calibration: One actual READ subprocess per shared calibration fixture. The fixed fit replays known schema outcomes and synthetic tariff scores; these are not extra executed policy trials. Record shared setup/observation/fit costs once, expose the identical frozen dataset to every arm.
execution: Task-major paired cells with deterministic rotated arm order; isolated fresh database per cell; at most one READ and one repair. No retries, refunds, replacement tasks or effects after an unknown READ result.
accounting: Charge an action's synthetic tariff before dispatch, including failure/timeout. Count actual outer cell wall from setup through independent evaluation, plus nested controller/subprocess timings without adding nested intervals twice. Wall budget is an observed admission/timeout bound, not a hard real-time guarantee.
limits: Trusted same-host process separation, not adversarial capability isolation
Known finite synthetic model; exact VOI and MPC can match
No learned state, model calls, native NDU evaluation, production workload or monetary savings
Tariff/reward units are synthetic and are never converted to measured nanoseconds or dollars
SQLite worker has no descendants; timed-out effects remain UNKNOWN even if later readback looks complete
